article.title: Gaza declares epidemic alert after meningitis claimed 15 lives
article.author: Aseel Saleh
article.content: On Tuesday, November 24, the Ministry of Health in the Gaza Strip declared an “epidemic alert” across all governorates, after 1,790 meningitis cases were recorded, adding that at least 15 people had died from the infectious disease. The ministry warned of an increase in fatalities due to meningitis, particularly among children. It attributed the surge in cases to the repercussions of Israel’s genocidal aggression against Gaza and its continued ban on the entry of medicine and other essential supplies into the war-ravaged territory. Read more: The daily reality of Israel’s mass extermination of life in Gaza The director general of the Gaza Health Ministry, Dr. Munir al-Bursh, told Al Jazeera that Israel’s genocidal aggression on the besieged Strip has poisoned the environment, citing a recent report published by Oxfam that addressed the crisis. “The [Israeli] occupation committed environmental war crimes in Gaza, destroying vital infrastructure across the Strip – including potable water networks and sewage pumping stations. With only 19% of Gaza’s sewage pumping stations remaining functional, existing water supplies contaminated by sewage, and a severe shortage of clean water for sanitation, the inevitable result is the outbreak of meningitis,” Dr. Munir said. The prominent Palestinian health official demanded that the international community fulfill its responsibilities and pressure Israel to allow the entry of desalination plants and necessary pumps into Gaza. Moreover, experts suggest that mass displacement resulting in overcrowded tents and schools has further exacerbated the meningitis outbreak, as Israel continues to hinder reconstruction efforts and restrict the entry of prefabricated homes and building materials. Meanwhile, the lack of essential nutrients, protein, and vitamins caused by the ongoing aid blockade has led to widespread malnutrition. This, in turn, has weakened immune defenses in infants and young children, sparking a surge in meningitis. Israeli assault leaves over 99% of Gaza environmentally contaminated, says Oxfam On Monday, November 23, a report titled “Environmental War Crimes: How Israel’s military assault has turned Gaza into a toxic wasteland, threatening human survival” was released by Oxfam and the Conflict and Environment Observatory (CEOBS). According to the findings in the report, Israel’s military onslaught has caused extensive environmental contamination throughout Gaza. Toxins that encompass heavy metals, explosive remnants, asbestos from demolished structures, dioxins, and biological hazards currently threaten the critical ecosystems upon which Gaza’s residents depend for their survival. The investigation shows how Israel’s widespread military operations have affected roughly 78% of Gaza’s territory, while spatial analysis indicates potential contamination across over 99% of the region. It also demonstrates that environmental pollution now poses a threat to almost the entire Strip. “Israel’s ongoing genocide in Gaza includes military assaults on its environment, which are environmental war crimes threatening life now and for generations to come. The destruction and contamination of Gaza will have fundamentally degraded the environmental conditions necessary for human safety and survival,” Oxfam International Executive Director Amitabh Behar noted. “This would breach Israel’s legal obligations under international humanitarian and human rights law,” Behar emphasized.
